spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (वदति-ते वदयति-ते)
1 To inform, to speak to or tell, to declare.
2 To speak articulately.
3 To abide.
With अनु,
(अनुवदते)
To speak similarly or subsequent.
With अप prefixed,
(अपवदति-ते)
To reprove, to censure.
With अभि,
To salute respectfully or by name.
With उप,
(उपवदते)
To explain.
With निर्,
To speak out or [] plainly.
With परि,
(परिवदति)
To speak against.
With प्र,
To rumour, to slander.
With प्रति,
(प्रतिवदति)
To reply to or answer.
With वि,
(विवदते)
To dispute.
With वि and प्र,
(विप्रवदति or -ते)
To wrangle or dispute together.
With वि and सं,
To break a promise.
With सम and प्र,
(सष्प्रवदते)
To speak articulately in concert;
(सष्प्रवदति)
To utter or articulate sounds together.
(इ,) वदि (वंदते)
1 To salute with reverence or respect.
2 To praise, to eulogize.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Speaking, able to speak, speaking well or sensibly.
E.
वद to speak, अच् aff.

m. (-दः)
1 Demonstrated conclusion, reply, result.
2 Discourse, discussion, defined as the speech of one desirous to know the truth.
3 A plaint, an accusation.
4 Sound, sounding.
E.
वद to speak, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्)
Speaking, saying.
E.
वद to speak, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
1 The mouth, the face.
2 The summit or apex of a triangle.
E.
वद to speak, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-नं)
Sound, sounding, (as musical instruments.)
E.
वद to sound, causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-जं)
The face of a mistress.
E.
वदन, and सरोज a lotus; also similar compounds, as वदनाम्बुरुह, वदनारविन्द, &c.

m. (-वः)
Saliva, the moisture of the lips.
E.
वदन the mouth, and आसव spirituous liquor.

m. (-न्दुः)
The face.
E.
वदन, and इन्दु the moon; also similar compounds, as वदनत्रन्द्र, &c.

f. (-न्तिः-न्ती)
Speech, discourse, talk.
E.
वद to say or speak, झिच् Uṇādi aff., ङीष् optionally added.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Munificent, bountiful.
E.
वद to speak, aff. अन्य; also वदान्य.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
1 Liberal, munificent.
2 Speaking kindly or agreeably.
3 Eloquent.
E.
वद to speak, आन्य Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Munificent, liberal, &c.
E.
वदान्य, and अण् pleonasm added.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Saying, calling.
2 Glorifying, boasting.
E.
वद to speak, शानच् aff.

m. (-कः)
The jujube: see वदरि.

m. (-लः)
A sheat-fish, (Silurus Boalis, HAM.)
E.
वद to speak, aff. आलच्; also with कन् added, वदालक. m. (-कः.)

n. (-लं)
Liquorice, or the root of the Abrus precatorius, which is used for it.
E.
वा for वात wind, दल to disperse, aff. अच्; form irr.

m. (-लः)
A sheat fish.
E.
वदाल the same, अण् pleonasm added.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Speaking, a speaker, able to speak, able to speak well, eloquent.
E.
वद to speak, aff. अच्, the root repeated, and आ inserted.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Causing or making a dispute.
E.
वाद, and कर what makes; also वादकृत्, &c.

mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्)
Sounding, playing, (as on a musical instrument.)
E.
वद to speak, causal v., शतृ aff.

n. (-द्धं)
Controversy, dispute.
E.
वाद, and युद्ध war.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The religious fig tree.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Adhering to or following a doctrine.
2 Addicted to controversy, disputatious.
E.
वाद, and रत fond of.

m. (-णः)
A name of VYĀSA, the compiler of the Vedas, and reputed author of the Purāṇas, &c.
E.
वादर a place of pilgrimage, अयन going, aff. अण्.

m. (-दी)
A Jaina.
E.
वाद result, truth, and वादिन् who declares.

n. (-नं)
Argument, maintaining a controversy.
E.
वाद, and साधन instrument.

m. (-दः)
Attack and rejoinder, plaint and reply.
E.
वाद, and अनुवाद subsequent dispute.

mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि)
Wise, learned, skilful, sage.
E.
वद to speak, (wisely, &c.,) इञ् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A musical instrument.
E.
वद to sound, Uṇādi aff. णित्रन्.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Speaking, discoursing.
2 Asserting, declaring.
m. (-दी)
1 A sage, an expounder of the law and the Śāstras.
2 A plaintiff, an accuser.
3 Leading or key note, (in music.)
E.
वद to speak, णिनि aff.

m. (-राट्)
A Bauddha sage; also MAÑJUGHOṢA.
E.
वादि a sage, and राज् chief.

m. (-शः)
A learned and virtuous man, a sage, a seer.
E.
वादि truth or true conclusion, and इशच् aff.

n. (-द्यं)
Any musical instrument.
E.
वद to sound, aff. ण्यत्; to be sounded or played.

m. (-षः)
The sound of musical instruments.
E.
वाद्य a musical instrument, and निर्घोष sound.

n. (-ण्डं)
1 A multitude of musical instruments, a band.
2 Any musical instrument.
E.
वाद्य a musical instrument, and भाण्ड assemblage or vessel.
